name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts
description: A monk who blends martial training with sorcerer magic, casting spells alongside unarmed strikes.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You cast Sorcerer-list spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability, and an Arcane Focus works as your focus. You know 2 cantrips (a 3rd at Monk level 10) and prepare level 1+ spells per the subclass table (3 at level 3, up to 13 at level 20), regaining slots on a Long Rest. Blade Ward, Thunderclap, Jump, Magic Missile and Shield are suggested picks; for multiclass slots you count one third of your Monk levels.

features.name: Mystic Fighting Style
features.text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your Unarmed Strikes with a Sorcerer cantrip you know that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Mystic Focus
features.text: You can spend a spell slot (no action) to regain Focus Points equal to the slot's level. When you finish a Short Rest or use Uncanny Metabolism, you can turn Focus Points into one spell slot of level 4 or lower: level 1 costs 2 points (Monk 6+), level 2 costs 3 (Monk 7+), level 3 costs 5 (Monk 13+), level 4 costs 6 (Monk 19+).

features.name: Focused Strike
features.text: After you use Stunning Strike, whether or not the target's save succeeds, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style
features.text: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace two of its Unarmed Strikes with a level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell that has a casting time of an action, cast as part of that same Bonus Action.
